### Background information:
 - Exact URL:    (includes specific episode show): [e.g. amazon.de/.., amazon.com/.., netflix.ca/..]
 - Country:       [e.g Germany (need to know for my vpn)]
 - Browser:       [e.g. chrome, firefox]
 - Addon-Version: [e.g. 1.0.74 seen if you click on settings]
 - Upload the visual UI on your end with the extension https://www.getsinglefile.com/ if the bug is about a feature totally not working.

### Describe the bug
What feature is the bug regardig? e.g. Freevee ad
A clear and concise description of what the bug is and how to reproduce.
